WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_quantity,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND derived_total_cost != 0 
        THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost
        ELSE NULL 
      END
    ) as avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_of_avg_quantities
  FROM step1
)
SELECT
  s1.invoice_number,
  s1.avg_quantity,
  s1.avg_cost_ratio,
  s1.avg_quantity - s2.avg_of_avg_quantities as difference
FROM step1 s1
CROSS JOIN step2 s2
WHERE s2.avg_of_avg_quantities IS NOT NULL
  AND s1.avg_quantity > s2.avg_of_avg_quantities
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
